about: 2D side-scrolling platformer where you play a little robot who can shoot with his cannon arm to destroy boxes and enemies alike. Run, jump, shoot, collect batteries or bonus life and reach the heart machine at the end of the level. You'll also encounter pitfall, laser or saw traps, and laser canon along your way to escape your prison ship into space.
Remote Play allows users to connect to and play games on their PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5 using a mobile device, PC, or another PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5.
One-time licence fee to download to multiple PS4 systems. Sign in to PlayStation is not required to use this on your primary PS4, but is required for use on other PS4 systems.
See Health Warnings for important health information before using this product.
